$comment: Mon roster. Each entry is the JSON encoding of the three-tab template in SPEC.md section 9. Names are working titles. Learnsets are empty because move pools are TBD in v0.1 -- see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md section 3.

engine.name: Emberkit
engine.body: Quadruped, hand-sized. Coat of fine ash that lifts when it runs.

entries.text: Runs before it can stand. Trainers find them by the scorch-line of pawprints, never by the animal itself.
The ash on its coat is spent fuel. A healthy Emberkit sheds a fingerprint's worth every hour and is always faintly warm to hold.
It strikes hardest the moment it is loosed and softens thereafter. Old handlers say the trick is to make the first exchange the only one that matters.

dex.whereFound: Dry scrub and burn scars, in the first season after a fire.

originDetail.value: Litters of two to four, born in the ash bed of a spent fire.

dex.evolutionNotes: Evolves as its coat thickens past what it can shed, forcing the heat inward.

engine.name: Cindermaw
engine.body: Long-limbed, knee-high. Jaw vents heat when it breathes out.

entries.text: It no longer sheds. Everything it used to give off to the air now goes down its throat and stays there.
Fast enough to open and close a fight before the other animal has turned to face it. It has no plan for a fight that lasts.
Cornered and hurt, it burns hotter -- which is the whole problem with it, and the reason it rarely reaches its third year in the wild.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Emberkit. Wild specimens hold territory along ridgelines.

originDetail.value: Does not breed at this stage.

dex.evolutionNotes: The jaw vents open at maturity. Handlers file the change under 'the animal deciding what to do with what it can no longer let go of'.

engine.name: Pyrelash
engine.body: Shoulder-height, whip-tailed. Leaves a standing line of heat behind a charge.

entries.text: The fastest thing on four legs in its range, and it knows the number exactly. It will not start a chase it has already lost.
The line of heat behind a charge hangs in the air long enough to read. Trackers follow it the way they would follow a wake.
It drinks fire. A Pyrelash walked into a burning stand of scrub will come out of it heavier than it went in.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Cindermaw. Not found wild at this stage.

originDetail.value: Breeding pairs hold a burn scar between them for as long as it stays open ground.

dex.evolutionNotes: Final stage of the Fire starter line. Gains Phantom: what the line spent two stages swallowing does not stay wholly in the body. The standing line of heat behind a charge is the visible part of it.

engine.name: Rillet
engine.body: Otter-shaped, forearm-length. Fur sheds water so completely it is dry the moment it surfaces.

entries.text: Keeps to water shallow enough to stand in. It is a poor swimmer and an excellent waiter.
It mends while it is still winning and stops the moment it starts losing, which is either very sensible or exactly backwards depending on who you ask.
Water thrown at a Rillet is water given to it. Every handler learns this once, usually in front of other handlers.

dex.whereFound: Streams, drainage ditches, and the slow ends of rivers.

originDetail.value: Single pups, born in a bank hollow above the waterline.

dex.evolutionNotes: Evolves once it can hold its own weight against a current.

engine.name: Tidecalf
engine.body: Barrel-chested, knee-high. Moves on land like something that would rather not.

entries.text: Slow on every axis and hard to move off any of them. It wins by still being there.
It can hold a stretch of shallow water against animals twice its weight, and does so without ever appearing to have decided to.
Bulls call across open water at dusk. The sound carries far enough that two Tidecalves who have never met can agree on a boundary.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Rillet. Wild specimens hold estuary shallows.

originDetail.value: Loose herds of six to ten, without hierarchy.

dex.evolutionNotes: Gains the depth to hunt below the surface rather than from it.

engine.name: Brinemoor
engine.body: Bulk of a small boat. Carries a standing swell around itself in still water.

entries.text: It has no fast answer to anything and does not need one. Fights against a Brinemoor are lost slowly.
The swell it carries is not decoration. It is the animal keeping a working depth of water around itself at all times.
Mending faster than it is being hurt is its whole strategy, and against a patient opponent it is not enough. Against an impatient one it has never once failed.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Tidecalf. Not found wild at this stage.

originDetail.value: Pairs hold a stretch of coast for life and tolerate juveniles of any line within it.

dex.evolutionNotes: Final stage of the Water starter line. Gains Psychic: the call a Tidecalf uses to agree a boundary becomes, at this size, something closer to a conversation held across open water.

engine.name: Loambit
engine.body: Squat digger, two hands' span. Plated across the shoulders and back.

entries.text: Digs before it fights and fights only where it has already dug.
A healthy Loambit cannot be taken down in one blow from full health. It will be standing at the end of it, badly, and that is generally enough.
It reads ground the way other animals read weather. Nothing buried in soil has ever caught one.

dex.whereFound: Turned earth, riverbanks, and the spoil heaps outside quarries.

originDetail.value: Clutches of three to six, in a chamber a body-length down.

dex.evolutionNotes: Evolves when its shoulder plates fuse into a single working shield.

engine.name: Cragmole
engine.body: Thigh-high, front-heavy. Forelimbs ending in single fused blades.

entries.text: The blades are for rock. It has learned they work on other things and has not thought much further about it.
Its plates are edged. Anything that closes with a Cragmole pays for the contact whether the Cragmole does anything about it or not.
Quarry crews have followed Cragmole workings to seams they had missed. The animal is a better surveyor than most surveyors.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Loambit. Wild specimens work the same tunnel system for years.
dex.evolutionNotes: Trades the last of its speed for the forelimbs.

engine.name: Terrabulk
engine.body: Shoulder-height and twice as long. Carries a course of set stone across its back.

entries.text: It moves last in almost every exchange and hits hardest in almost every exchange. The two facts are the same fact.
The stone on its back is set, not grown, and it sets it itself. No two are alike and none of them are structurally unsound.
It cannot be taken out of a fight from full health, cannot be hurried, and cannot be gone around. Handlers describe working with one as negotiating with a hillside.

dex.whereFound: Evolves from Cragmole. Not found wild at this stage.

originDetail.value: Solitary. Meets others only to breed, and returns to its own workings after.

dex.evolutionNotes: Final stage of the Earth starter line. Gains Steel: the course of stone it sets across its back is smelted, not gathered. It is the only thing in the line that makes rather than moves material.
